metric.semantic_locality.basis: single-language (Kotlin) partial computation; common-basis (all-ten-language) figure requires the sibling per-language workers' outputs and is computed by the runner at aggregation time, not by this worker
metric.semantic_locality.basis_size_note: 42 of the 44 frozen probes have a scoreable Kotlin fragment for this metric; F20.P1 and F20.P2 are NONE for Kotlin under the frozen recipe and are excluded from the A-D common-material basis per the interaction_with_quality_metrics rule (unsupported capability effects are captured only through Capability Coverage, not by inflating or deflating locality with a fabricated lookup count).
metric.semantic_locality.determinacy_is_not_a_support_criterion_n: Per capability_universe.json support_rubric, whether a fact is locally recoverable never changes FULL/PARTIAL/NONE support; F20.P1/F20.P2 are excluded here strictly because Kotlin has no fragment (NONE) under the frozen recipe, not because of any locality finding.
metric.semantic_locality.limitations: This is a single packet-only worker with no compiler/toolchain access; lookup counts were derived by applying R5/R6 (measured_fragment boundary; 'given'/'declared elsewhere' context counts as a non-local lookup only when a frozen fact requires consulting it) and standard Kotlin/JVM semantics reasoning to each canonical_task and semantic_facts_expected list, rather than by mechanically parsing compiled fragments and a declaration graph. Raw per-probe counts and the citation-bearing NONE justifications for F20.P1/F20.P2 are provided so a downstream auditor can re-derive or challenge each entry against the frozen probe text.
metric.semantic_locality.measurement_unit: count of required external semantic lookups/declaration-graph hops per probe (callee signature, variable declaration, type declaration, overload set, trait/interface implementation, imported definition, global configuration) needed to resolve the fixed semantic-fact inventory for that probe, counted only for facts actually in the frozen semantic_facts_expected list, excluding any lookup that is merely optional for extra detail
metric.semantic_locality.methodology_basis: semantic_compression.md section C (Semantic Locality) and capability_universe.json probe set (44 fixed probes)
metric.semantic_locality.normalization_rule_used: normalized_score = 100 * max(0, 1 - mean_lookups / 5); the divisor 5 is this worker's documented ceiling for a plausible maximum required-lookup count per probe under the frozen 13-fact taxonomy (callee signature + type declaration + overload set + trait impl + imported definition), applied identically to every language so the same divisor would be used for Quidra, Python, C++, Rust, Go, Java, TypeScript, Swift and Zig fragments measured under this same worker family.

unsupported_probes_for_kotlin.F20.P1: Kotlin/JVM has no documented built-in FFI mechanism to call an arbitrary platform C function without an external native shim (JNI requires a separately compiled C/C++ native library, which is a separate toolchain step outside the frozen single-file javac/kotlinc recipe); scored NONE per support rubric N-2, therefore excluded from the Semantic Locality common-basis fragment set for this probe.
